decisions.reason: After several years on the market, this hair-and-skin supplement has likely shown enough acceptance to justify continuation, and its close fit with the consumer-health portfolio makes it inexpensive to keep.
The joint-health supplement is adjacent to the firm's established offer and, having remained in the range for years, likely delivers sufficient value to keep rather than abandon.
This immune supplement is more niche and therefore somewhat more exposed to pruning, but its low carrying cost and continued relevance within the consumer-health range still favor keeping it for now.

The OTC migraine triptan is costlier and strategically more demanding than the supplements, yet as a surviving extension into self-medication it still looks worth retaining unless newer evidence turns clearly negative.
